meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 做 Git 操作时,Claude 会先判断你要提交、改写历史还是查历史;提交时会按改动文件数拆成多个小提交,并模仿仓库原有提交风格。
howto.when: 当你说出“commit”“rebase”“squash”,或问“谁写了这段代码”“某个改动何时被加进去”等 Git 相关请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动拆成多个小提交,每个独立成一条。
say.note: 会按目录和用途分组后分批提交。

say.text: 把最近三条提交用 squash 合并成一条。
say.note: 会通过 rebase 改写并整理本地历史。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是哪次提交加进来的,谁写的。
say.note: 会用 git log/blame 定位改动来源。

howto.what_en: When asked to do Git work, Claude first detects the task type (commit, rebase, or history lookup). For commits, it splits changes into multiple atomic commits and matches the repo's existing commit language and style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that', or similar Git-related requests.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several small, focused commits.
Squash the last three commits into one.
Find which commit added this line and who wrote it.
say_en.note: Uses git log/blame to trace the change.
